digest.component_or_area: repository-wide code quality, architecture, documentation, and test infrastructure assessment
propositions: 87 source modules exceed 500-LOC documented target; orchestration functions like compute() in next_batch.py and import_tickets() in import_ndjson.py combine multiple concerns at high complexity, requiring continued shrink-only ratchet enforcement

Mypy global pass masks 687 untyped-definition errors; only graph and grounding packages enforce strictness, requiring gradual package-by-package disallow-untyped-defs expansion and narrowing of ignore_missing_imports
Python 3.11 xdist worker flakiness in test_matching_guard_is_accepted causes spurious CI failures and 8–24 minute rerun latency; teardown/serialization investigation is required for gate reliability
README and user-guide assignee examples contradict config documentation on email/accountId requirement, creating user confusion

Documentation and workflow metadata drift: docs/README.md routes to obsolete config files, docs/mutation-testing.md records are stale (June/July 2026) without gating lane, and no systemic repository-wide package dependency/DAG contract exists to prevent cross-layer imports
